title: Mike McConnell linked to S4/Area 51 via Dan Burisch story

tellings.quote: I think he might have been talking about a guy named Mike McConnell, who became NSA director later. But he was involved in some S4 Area 51 stuff related to Dan Burisch, whose story I think honestly holds up a lot less than your story.

plain: Michels suggests that a man named Mike McConnell, who later led the NSA, the US eavesdropping and code-breaking agency, was involved in work at S4, a secret site said to sit near Area 51, the classified Air Force base in Nevada. He links McConnell to the story of a man named Dan Burisch, who claims to have worked there, and mentions a pilot named John Lear. Michels offers this as his own guess while talking to Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at S4, and adds that he thinks Burisch's story "holds up a lot less" than Lazar's.
